text:
morgan: FYI pushed a tiny hotpatch PR that bumps KV cache TTL back to 30s to stop p99 tail from spiking. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8457

alex: Can you tag the canary window you'd like? I can merge if CI passes.

morgan: Canary for 15m starting in ~5m if people are free. CI is flaky on the windows runner but linux passed. Change is one line:
```
- cache_ttl_ms: 500
+ cache_ttl_ms: 30000
```
Also added a safety fallback (circuit_breaker: true) in case of rapid regen.

jess: looking now, quick question — does this touch prefix caching keys or invalidation? if not, :+1:.

morgan: nope, only TTL, not key schema. Ran a short local sim and it reduced the tail.

sre-bot: Deploy scheduled to canary cluster c3 in 2m. Monitoring: metrics.p99_latency, metrics.error_rate, and logs.kv-miss-rate.

alex: CI green on linux; merging after canary window starts and I'll watch traces. Will ping @oncall on any regression. :shipit:

sam: watching dashboards — will call out if p99 > baseline + 15% or error_rate > 0.5%. :eyes:

morgan: thanks all, will post a rollback PR if we need to revert. Quick note: if we see a steady increase in kv-miss-rate, I'll revert immediately.
